items.title: We watch the feeds
items.text: We track what keeps coming up on TikTok, in Amazon best-seller and gift lists, and in the big tech YouTube channels’ reviews.

items.title: We check the facts
items.text: Launch dates and features come from the maker or reputable tech press. We don’t invent prices, star ratings or sales figures.

items.title: We add the catch
items.text: Every gadget gets a heads-up: subscriptions, ongoing costs, compatibility, safety or legal points that the hype videos skip.

items.title: You check the price
items.text: Prices move hourly, so “Check today’s price” opens a live retailer search for your country (US, UK or EU).

faqs.q: How do you decide which gadgets are trending?
faqs.a: We look for products that keep appearing across TikTok, Amazon best-seller and gift lists, and reviews from popular tech YouTubers, plus new launches from major brands. It’s an editorial shortlist, not a paid ranking: brands can’t pay to be listed.

Gadget prices change constantly and differ between the US, UK and Europe. Rather than show a price that may be wrong, each card shows a rough price band and a “Check today’s price” button that opens a live search at a retailer in your region.

faqs.q: Do influencers get paid to recommend these?
faqs.a: Often, yes. Many creators earn affiliate commission or receive free products. In the US the FTC, and in the UK the ASA, require them to disclose that clearly. See our guide to tech reviewers and how to spot paid posts.

faqs.q: Do you make money from ViralGadgets?
faqs.a: We may earn a commission when you buy through some links, at no extra cost to you. It never changes what we list or what we say about it. How we make money.
